workflow_blockers: generic repository test job installs no torch while collecting existing spatial tests that import torch
repository-wide Ruff has pre-existing findings in unrelated legacy files

expert_selection_methodology: candidate-library admission uses peer-reviewed capability evidence, modality/input-dimensionality scope, released native interface, and weight/audit availability
per-expert source qualification estimates action prevalence, conditional precision, utility, and harm separately
portfolio selection replays feasible verifier subsets on frozen source transactions to measure non-additive interactions
runtime can select the empty portfolio and exactly preserve the Generalist
target/test labels are forbidden for qualification, portfolio selection, or threshold changes
notes: The previous Tx-v2 source diagnosis found that fixing the specificity statistic alone cannot establish expert benefit because several source utility lower bounds remained non-positive.
The v3 portfolio is a source-only policy for deciding which qualified verifiers may run together; it is not a target-trained gate.
Research-roadmap models do not count as active coverage until their exact input/runtime contracts and source qualification are validated.
The final branch contains this validation-report-only commit after the validated code commit.
The MUSK adapter follows the official zero-shot head/normalization interface but has not loaded the gated checkpoint in this branch validation.
